description: Jeu 2048 local avec sauvegarde privée, commandes tactiles et vue détachable.
guide: 2048 is a solitaire puzzle. Use game.state to read the 16 cells in row-major order, score, revision and legalMoves. Use game.move with one of those legal directions and the exact revision. The engine merges equal adjacent tiles once per move and adds a random tile. A stale revision is refused: read state again, do not replay the old move. game.new starts a new game and requires its own permission. The human may play between agent turns. Agents should maximize score; never invent board state. The App's SDK agents.act can run one authorized model turn. Each seat uses a distinct session id.

actions.name: game.state
actions.description: Read the board, score, legal moves and revision.

actions.name: game.move
actions.description: Play one legal direction at the exact current revision.

actions.name: game.new
actions.description: Start a new game, replacing the current board.
